segmentation.text: intending to turn to the left
to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction
or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard,
but such driver, having so yielded
and having given a signal when and as required,
and the drivers of all other vehicles
approaching the intersection from the opposite direction
to the vehicle making the left turn.

elements.justification: The turning vehicle t: 'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle (ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate'); its driver is its controlled motion.
t 'within an intersection': t's footprint overlaps X (rel.occupies; st.intersection 'the region where two roadways meet').

'Having given a signal when and as required' of a left turn: sig.turn_indicator 'state ∈ {off, left, right}' at left, or sig.hand_signal 'meaning ∈ {..., left, ...}' at left — the two manners a signal of turning is given — at some observation since t came onto the carrier c1 it entered X from: the signal is required on the approach to the turn and through it, which is when the words look for it. The indicator is not a stand-in for the turn itself, which k reads separately.
'May make such left turn': t is making its turn, moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance) within X (rel.occupies) since its current movement within X began, with its left-turn plan declared (c).
'The drivers of all other vehicles': the subject, of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, other than t; 'drivers' read through the vehicles' controlled motion.

'Approaching the intersection': the subject occupies a carrier c2 whose entrance end is X (st.lane_enters, 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end') and does not yet overlap X; 'from the opposite direction', per rel.oncoming's not-a-stand-in clause, is c2's st.lane_direction opposed to that of the carrier c1 t entered X from, within p.oncoming_heading_cos.
Same mapping as 'shall yield' in the index: the subject does not proceed (kin.speed above the halt tolerance) while t is in conflict, and does not collide with it (rel.contact).
'The vehicle making the left turn' is t, of the admitted aggregate, within X (rel.occupies) making the turn the conditions a, b, c, i, j, k describe.

operationalizations.standard: the right-of-way: precedence owed where 'circumstances of direction, speed and proximity ... give rise to the danger of a crash' (DEF-NRS-484A-210)
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: a danger of a crash exists where, under constant velocities, the two centres approach within the time-to-collision threshold p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance; the subject proceeds where its speed exceeds p.halt_speed_tolerance

intentions.meaning: the source's current plan for the road user includes a turn to the left at the target region, the plan's preparation for that turn included

applicability: At every observation at which the subject occupies a carrier c2 that enters an intersection X (st.lane_enters c2 X) and does not overlap X, and some other road user t of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: overlaps X; declares int.left_turn at X at this observation; entered X (overlapping it continuously since) from a carrier c1 entering X whose designated direction has a dot product with c2's below minus p.oncoming_heading_cos; has been moving within X (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) at every observation since its current movement began — the later of its latest entry into X and its latest rise above p.halt_speed_tolerance while in X; showed a left signal (sig.turn_indicator left or sig.hand_signal left) at some observation since it came onto c1; and complied with NRS_484B_253_o1 (binder subject ↦ t) at the observation at which that current movement began: 'having so yielded'.
obligation: Re-binding X and c2, and quantifying every road user t as in the applicability: for every such t, the subject is not in contact with t (rel.contact), and it is not the case that the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) while prim.closest_approach_within(subject, t; p.conflict_horizon) holds with prim.closest_approach_distance(subject, t; p.conflict_horizon) below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'the drivers' are read through the vehicles' controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls them.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: t entered X from c1 showing sig.turn_indicator left, declares int.left_turn at X, and began moving into its turn when the subject, approaching on c2 (direction opposed to c1's), was far and not in conflict; t keeps moving; the subject keeps kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance and its closest approach to t lies within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; the subject slows and comes to rest on c2 short of X until t has completed its turn.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: t turns left in X but showed no left signal (sig.turn_indicator off, sig.hand_signal no_signal) since it came onto c1.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: t turning left in X, the subject approaching opposite in conflict; sig.turn_indicator and sig.hand_signal are absent, so whether t gave a signal is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: t, signalled, began its turn while the subject was already within the hazard bound of t (t did not comply with NRS_484B_253_o1 at its onset); the subject proceeds in conflict: t had not so yielded.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The subject approaches X with no vehicle turning left in X.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channels

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width

param_proposals.name: p.oncoming_heading_cos
param_proposals.convention: cosine of the largest angle off exactly opposed headings (about 25 degrees) at which two vehicles count as proceeding in opposite directions
param_proposals.source: skew tolerance of opposing intersection approaches
